review_candidates.title: Product Marketing Manager
review_candidates.description: At Mitel, you will have the opportunity to help businesses connect, collaborate and provide better experiences for our customers. You will deliver valuable contributions in creating business success within our global organization utilizing your unique attributes, skills and experience. Please take a moment to look over this opportunity and if interested, feel free to send us your application. If this is not the right opportunity for you, you can also sign up for Job Alerts by creating an account. This will give you a profile that you can use for all future applications, and you will be notified whenever a new position that matches your criteria becomes available. Overview Product Marketing at Mitel sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. In this role, you will translate complex communications technologies—including hybrid cloud platforms, mission-critical solutions, industry-specific deployments, and hardware—into compelling messaging that resonates with IT decision-makers, business leaders, partners, and customers across global markets. You will own product marketing strategy and execution for assigned product lines or solution areas, including positioning, messaging, go-to-market (GTM) planning, launch execution, and lifecycle marketing. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Regional Marketing, and external partners, you will drive market differentiation, product adoption, and effective market positioning across more than 100 countries. Responsibilities Messaging, Positioning & Value Creation: Develop and own product positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks, and differentiation strategies for assigned product lines or solutions. Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, buyer-relevant messaging for IT Directors, CIOs, business leaders, and technical stakeholders. Ensure consistent messaging across all customer-facing, partner-facing, and internal communications. Create and adapt content across multiple formats, including white papers, solution briefs, landing pages, sales presentations, video scripts, PR materials, and digital campaigns. Launch & Go-to-Market Ownership Own end-to-end go-to-market planning and execution for product launches across multiple regions. Develop launch strategies, messaging, audience segmentation, channel approaches, and success metrics. Build and manage integrated launch plans across Product, Engineering, Sales, Enablement, Regional Marketing, and agency partners. Identify risks, dependencies, and gaps early, and drive resolution to ensure successful launch execution. Ensure lifecycle marketing alignment post-launch, including adoption, upsell, and retention messaging. Cross-Functional Leadership Act as the primary bridge between Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to translate roadmaps and technical capabilities into market-ready messaging and campaigns. Partner with regional marketing teams across EMEA, North America, and APAC to ensure global strategies are effectively localized. Collaborate with Sales and Sales Enablement teams to develop market positioning, objection-handling guidance, and customer-facing enablement materials. Influence cross-functional stakeholders to align on messaging, priorities, and GTM execution plans. Market, Customer & Competitive Intelligence Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, key market players, and industry dynamics across enterprise communications and UCaaS markets. Monitor market trends, industry developments, and customer needs to identify opportunities, risks, and positioning strategies for Mitel. Gather and synthesize customer, partner, and sales feedback to refine positioning and identify market opportunities. Translate market insights into actionable positioning, messaging, and product marketing recommendations. Leverage competitive and market insights to support accurate positioning of Mitel and strengthen customer-facing messaging and sales enablement. Pricing, Packaging & Commercial Input Contribute to pricing and packaging strategies through market, customer, and competitive insights. Support Product Management and Revenue teams in evaluating pricing models, packaging structures, and market positioning. Provide data-driven recommendations based on customer behavior, win/loss analyses, and market benchmarks. Requirements Proven ability to create clear, persuasive, and high-impact messaging for diverse audiences and channels. Experience translating technical product concepts into business-value narratives and customer-facing content. Strong storytelling, editing, and content-structuring skills. 5–8+ years of experience in product marketing, B2B marketing, or go-to-market roles within a regional or global organization. Proven ownership of product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution. Experience supporting or leading complex product launches in enterprise technology environments. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing stakeholders. Ability to manage complex GTM programs with multiple dependencies, timelines, and global coordination requirements. Strong prioritization skills, execution discipline, and the ability to drive accountability without direct authority. Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing functions. Strong collaboration skills in global, matrixed environments. Ability to build alignment across diverse teams and geographies. Additional Skills (Advantageous) Fluency in French or German. Product marketing experience, including formal Product Marketing Manager (PMM) roles, launch ownership, or positioning work within a B2B technology environment. Telecommunications or UC industry experience, including familiarity with enterprise communications, cloud versus on-premises deployment models, or contact center solutions. What we offer? Professional Growth in a Global Company Individual Career Path Talent Program E-Learning Hub Knowledge Sharing Programs and Trainings Mentor Support Flexible Working Hours Home Office 26 Paid Vacation Days 5 Wellness Fridays Vacation Medical Care including Dental Care, Glasses, etc. Referral Bonus Food Vouchers Multisport Card Store Discounts Team Buildings and Company Events Lounge and Game Areas Metro Station next to the Office To ensure our hiring process is fair, efficient, and transparent, we want to inform all applicants that we may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, including third party tools to screen resumes and match candidates to job opportunities based on their skills and experience. All applications are also reviewed by our hiring team, and final decisions are made by our hiring managers. Kindly review our privacy policy (Mitel Privacy Policy) for more information and to understand how to exercise any of your rights. For more information, visit Why Mitel or follow us on LinkedIn here. Mitel is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. Diversity makes sense for us, for our customers and for our future. We value different perspectives, skills and experiences, and welcome applications from all sections of the community.

review_candidates.description: At Endeavor, we back the founders who will define the next decade of Ukraine's economy – not incrementally, and not from the sidelines. Success here isn't measured in activity. It's measured in the trust founders place in you and the outcomes you help them reach. We're looking for someone with real business firepower – the kind of person who has spent years in top-tier consulting, VC, PE, or a senior operating seat, and who can be a genuine thought partner to a unicorn founder rather than a note-taker. About Endeavor Endeavor is the leading global community of High-Impact Entrepreneurs in emerging markets. Present in 50+ markets, our 3100+ entrepreneurs rely on an unparalleled network of peers and mentors to solve their toughest challenges. Portfolio companies include Checkout.com (UAE), Carsome (Malaysia), and Rappi (Colombia). Our core belief is simple: entrepreneurs are the single best way to transform economies. With the right community, mentorship, and investment, they become the building blocks of thriving, dynamic ecosystems – and through the Endeavor Multiplier Effect, they reinvest their success forward by mentoring, investing in, and inspiring the next generation. Launched in late 2024, Endeavor office in Ukraine supports entrepreneurs behind some of the country's most ambitious companies, including Preply, Ajax Systems and Solidgate. To sustain its model long-term, Endeavor launched Endeavor Catalyst, a global co-investment fund with $540M+ AUM and 400+ investments across 35+ countries. Endeavor Catalyst has already backed two Ukrainian-founded companies: Headway Inc and Holywater Tech. What You'll Do Entrepreneur Portfolio Management & Advisory (50%) The Heart Of The Job Own relationships with a portfolio of founders as their primary point of contact, account manager, and strategic advisor Build deep, trust-based relationships and develop a founder's-eye understanding of each business – model, growth levers, priorities, and challenges Run regular check-ins, spot critical moments and growth bottlenecks before they become fires, and design tailored interventions across internationalization, fundraising, go-to-market, org design, pricing, and talent Own the full connection journey – from problem identification to expert and mentor matching to follow-through – ensuring real outcomes, not just introductions Activate Endeavor's global network (50 markets, 3,100+ entrepreneurs, 4,000+ mentors) to put the right person in front of your founder at the right moment Track the metrics that matter – growth, fundraising, talent, engagement – and turn them into actionable insight Measure entrepreneur satisfaction and continuously improve how we deliver value Ecosystem & Network Development (20%) Build and deepen relationships with investors, corporates, accelerators, government bodies, and international partners Identify and recruit high-caliber mentors and board members for our entrepreneurs Manage the Investor and Mentor Network platforms, facilitating meaningful, ongoing connections Design and run high-impact moments: Founder Circles, fireside chats, masterclasses, roundtables, and 1-on-1 mentor sessions Represent Endeavor at major conferences and ecosystem events, in Ukraine and abroad Selection Support (20%) Identify and evaluate high-potential companies for Endeavor selection Conduct due diligence – business model analysis, market assessment, founder evaluation Prepare candidates and candidate profiles for Endeavor Local and International Selection Panels (LSP & ISP) Strategy & Special Projects (10%) Contribute to Endeavor Ukraine's strategic planning, OKR-setting, and annual roadmap Collaborate with Endeavor Global on cross-border initiatives, best-practice sharing, and global programs Support fundraising and partnership development with compelling materials and data Lead or support strategic special projects, education initiatives, and more What We're Looking For Must-Have Business acumen. You read a company fast – model, unit economics, growth levers – and give structured, actionable advice a sophisticated founder respects Reasoning ability. You think from first principles, break complex problems into their parts, resist easy answers, and catch the details that matter Track record of trust. You've built and held real relationships with founders and C-level leaders, and people turn to you when the stakes are high Ownership. Entrepreneurial mindset – high autonomy, comfort with ambiguity, bias toward action, and genuine urgency to support founders Service first. You ask “how can I help?” before “what's in it for me?” Communication. Outstanding written and spoken Ukrainian and English (C1+) Experience. 5-8+ years in management consulting (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or strong tier-2), VC, PE, investment banking, or a senior strategy/operating role at a high-growth tech company Passion for entrepreneurship and Ukraine's success Nice-to-Have Experience inside a leading tech company or a VC fund International work experience or exposure to global business environments Ecosystem-building, accelerator, or impact-oriented experience A top-tier MBA or relevant graduate degree (nice, not essential) Salesforce, CRM, or portfolio management tools Conversational or working Spanish If you like the role and believe you could excel in it, don't self-reject. How We Hire We move fast and we're clear at every step, because good people have options and a foggy process tells them the wrong thing about us. Expect roughly a month from first conversation to decision. Here's what to expect along the way: Conversations with both our local team and the wider Endeavor network – because this role plugs into a community that spans 50 markets, and we want you to feel that from the start Interviews conducted in both Ukrainian and English A practical task – a real slice of the job followed by a conversation where we walk through your thinking together A clear decision, and hopefully an offer Throughout, expect to always know where you stand: every applicant hears back within several working days. We set the bar high and we won't extend an offer until we're confident we've found the right person. The founders you'll support expect a lot of us, and the process is our first chance to show you we hold ourselves to the same standard. What We Offer A seat in the room. A senior role shaping how Ukraine's top founders are supported and scaled globally – you won't be reading about the big moments, you'll be in them. Real relationships, not networking. Direct, meaningful access to the country's most ambitious entrepreneurs, built over years, not events. A network most people spend a career trying to access. 50 markets, thousands of founders, investors and mentors – yours to activate on day one. A passport that gets real use. Regular travel to Endeavor markets and programming across our global hubs, including London, New York, and San Francisco. Rooms full of people worth learning from. Direct exposure to world-class business leaders, investors, and thought leaders – not from a stage, but across the table. Investment in you, not just your output. Professional development through Endeavor's international retreats and training programs. Pay that reflects the weight of the role, plus a performance bonus tied to OKR achievement. Health insurance. 24 paid vacation days. Flexible, hybrid work from our Kyiv office – because presence here is part of doing this job well. Work that matters, with people who mean it. A mission-driven team building something real for Ukraine's future. Before you apply This is a demanding role. We're ambitious, we hold ourselves to a high – and rising – standard, and the founders we support expect a lot. That's exactly what makes the work meaningful, and it means we're looking for someone who runs toward that intensity, not away from it. If this role speaks to you and you're ready to give it your best, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now – we can't wait to meet you. Location Being based in Kyiv matters for this role – it's where the relationships, the team, and the moments that count actually happen. We're flexible on working hours and don't expect daily office presence, but this one is a firm requirement: we can only consider candidates already based in Kyiv or planning to relocate here. Who You Are We don't just write our values down, we live by them. Every hire, every decision, every hard call gets measured against them. We're looking for someone who embodies… Entrepreneur First: You are someone who passionately believes in the power of high-impact entrepreneurs to change the world for the better. You care about our mission Go Big: You are someone whose curiosity drives them to dream (and execute!) big. You are a self-starter, who will roll up your sleeves to take our office to the next level Network of Trust: You are someone who can naturally build trust with anybody, from CTOs of cutting-edge startups to CEOs of established ventures Pay It Forward: You are someone with a service-oriented attitude, who asks “What can I do?” before asking “What can I get?” One Endeavor: You are someone who thrives on working with colleagues in over 30 different countries around the world. You are collaborative and a bridge builder Always Agile: You are someone who understands that it's the planning, not the plans, that matter and therefore isn't deterred by pivots or evolutions

OKTAGON is one of Europe's leading MMA organisations, and Germany is a huge part of our story. We're growing, pushing boundaries and bringing unforgettable live experiences to thousands of fans. But great events don't just happen. They take people who know how to organise chaos, keep things moving and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. That's why we're looking for an Event Production Specialist for Germany to join our production team in PRAGUE . Just graduated or new to events? review_candidates.title: Integration Specialist
review_candidates.description: 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁 bij 𝗰𝘁𝗿𝗹 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀. Integraties. Zonder gedoe. In april 2025 zijn we begonnen met een simpel idee: integraties moeten gewoon werken. Ruim anderhalf jaar later zijn we een team van 8 mensen en werken we voor bedrijven in de scheepsbouw, superjachtbouw, shipping, havenlogistiek, automotive, food, retail en de maakindustrie. Wat al die bedrijven gemeen hebben? Hun systemen moeten met elkaar praten. Een order uit een webshop die automatisch in het ERP landt. Een EDI bericht van een leverancier dat zonder handwerk verwerkt wordt. Een onderdelenbestelling die direct bij de dealer binnenkomt. Dat is wat wij bouwen. Steeds meer bedrijven weten ons te vinden. Daarom zoeken we een Integration Specialist die het leuk vindt om technische puzzels op te lossen en mee te bouwen aan een bedrijf dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Geen vacature vol buzzwords. Geen ninja, rockstar of 360 consultant. Gewoon iemand met hersens, nieuwsgierigheid en zin om iets op te bouwen. 𝗪𝗮𝘁 𝗷𝗲 𝗴𝗮𝗮𝘁 𝗱𝗼𝗲𝗻 Je werkt aan koppelingen tussen ERP systemen, webshops, portalen en SaaS platformen. Via API’s, EDI (EDIFACT, X12), AS2 en SFTP. Ons belangrijkste gereedschap is het Lobster platform. Je vertaalt klantprocessen naar technische oplossingen en zorgt dat data betrouwbaar van A naar B stroomt. Je gaat onder andere: • klantprocessen vertalen naar werkende integraties • mappings en koppelingen bouwen, testen en onderhouden • meedenken over de beste technische oplossing voor klanten • fouten analyseren en structureel oplossen • zorgen dat integraties stabiel blijven draaien • meebouwen aan onze eigen tooling, documentatie en standaardoplossingen Kortom: jij zorgt dat systemen doen wat ze moeten doen. 𝗪𝗶𝗲 𝘄𝗲 𝘇𝗼𝗲𝗸𝗲𝗻 Iemand die technisch is, logisch denkt en graag wil leren. Je hoeft geen jaren ervaring te hebben. Nieuwsgierigheid en snel schakelen vinden we belangrijker dan een perfect cv. Je: • denkt analytisch en doorziet processen snel • bent nieuwsgierig en durft vragen te stellen • krijgt energie van technische puzzels • bouwt graag aan oplossingen die echt gebruikt worden • werkt zelfstandig en ook graag samen • hebt interesse in integraties, API’s, data en bedrijfsprocessen • woont op reisafstand van ons kantoor in Eindhoven en kunt daar regelmatig werken Ervaring met Lobster is mooi meegenomen. Een vereiste is het niet, dat leren we je. 𝗛𝗼𝗲 𝘄𝗲 𝘄𝗲𝗿𝗸𝗲𝗻 We werken grotendeels samen op kantoor in Eindhoven, en daarnaast bij klanten en thuis. We geloven in flexibel werken. Tegelijk merken we dat leren en bouwen gewoon sneller gaat wanneer je regelmatig naast elkaar zit. Elke maandag starten we met de weekly tech: wat doen we deze week en welke tickets staan open. Op vrijdag zitten we samen in de mapping room om mappings en klanten door te nemen. Je komt in een klein team waar veel gebeurt, veel mogelijk is en waar je echt invloed hebt op hoe we dingen doen. 𝗛𝗼𝗲 𝗵𝗲𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝗼𝗺 𝗯𝗶𝗷 𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝘁𝗲 𝘄𝗲𝗿𝗸𝗲𝗻 We zijn klein genoeg om flexibel te zijn en groot genoeg om impact te maken. Lijnen zijn kort, beslissingen worden snel genomen en iedereen denkt mee. Je werkt zelfstandig aan je eigen klanten en projecten, met een team dat altijd klaarstaat als je vastloopt. Vragen stellen is hier geen zwakte. Zo leren we allemaal. We houden van mensen die dingen oppakken, eerlijk zeggen wat ze ervan vinden en het leuk vinden om samen iets beter te maken. "𝗰𝘁𝗿𝗹 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 begon als een klein bedrijf en voor mij was dat een mooie instap om hier te beginnen en samen verder te bouwen aan iets groots. Je leert veel over ICT en techniek, en door de consultancy ook veel over de bedrijfsprocessen van verschillende klanten. Het werk is innovatief en leerzaam, en vooral leuk omdat we een klein team zijn waarin je je collega's vaak ziet en spreekt." Max, Integration Specialist 𝗪𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗱𝗶𝘁 𝗹𝗲𝘂𝗸 𝗶𝘀 Bij 𝗰𝘁𝗿𝗹 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 stap je in op een moment waarop we groeien, professionaliseren en nog volop aan het bouwen zijn. Naast klantwerk bouwen we ook aan eigen oplossingen, zoals ons orderportaal voor SCSN klanten. Je denkt dus mee over processen, standaarden en tooling, en over hoe we als bedrijf verder groeien. 𝗪𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗲 𝗯𝗶𝗲𝗱𝗲𝗻 • veel ruimte om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen • verantwoordelijkheid vanaf het begin • begeleiding van mensen met jarenlange ervaring in integraties • afwisselende klanten in heel verschillende sectoren • 8% vakantiegeld • 10% pensioenbijdrage • de kans om mee te groeien met 𝗰𝘁𝗿𝗹 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗞𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘁 𝗴𝗼𝗲𝗱? Reageer via LinkedIn of stuur je cv en een kort bericht waarom jij denkt dat je bij ons past. Dat zegt ons vaak al genoeg. 📧 yannick@ctrlintegrations.com 📍 Locatie: Eindhoven 🕓 Dienstverband: 32 tot 40 uur
